name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.0 degrees south of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 9 times in 3 visits over 39 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 18 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 39 hours starting 2025-10-24, at wavelengths from 0.82 to 4.24 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
